bodySearch.label: Show the pick-list's own search box?
bodySearch.description: Embeds a search box above the pick-list. Set true only when the page has no other search affordance (e.g. no page-level std-search), so the surface shows one search box instead of two. False is the default — this atom has never had a search box (0 consumers today).
bodySearch.synonyms: inline search, list search, built-in search, show search

filterBarLook.label: Filter bar look
filterBarLook.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
filterBarLook.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

displayPageSize.label: How many candidates to show at once?
displayPageSize.description: Rows visible per page before the data-grid's own pagination control appears — 20 matches the pick-list density sweet spot (Miller's law, 10-25 rows).
displayPageSize.synonyms: visible rows, items per page, display limit, show per page

filters.label: Which filters should appear above the pick-list?
filters.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the rows; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this list and routes XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path. Use this knob only for a standalone pick-list with no page-level filter affordance.
filters.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

pageSize.label: How many candidates per page when paging?
pageSize.description: Records fetched from the server per REFETCH_PAGE request. The initial load and search/filter refetches remain unpaginated (load every candidate) unless a consumer wires REFETCH_PAGE, so the default pick-list surface is unchanged. Safe to page: this atom's selection is a single transient id (never an accumulated array), so no already-picked item can be stranded on another page.
pageSize.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, page limit

searchPlaceholder.label: Search box placeholder text
searchPlaceholder.description: Hint text inside the pick-list search box.
searchPlaceholder.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text

tableLook.label: Table look
tableLook.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the data table rendered by this atom.
